headline: Top Accor shareholder Parvus Asset Management demands removal of CEO
summary: UK investment fund Parvus Asset Management, holding a 14.1% stake in French hotel group Accor, demanded the removal of Chief Executive Officer Sébastien Bazin ahead of the upcoming annual meeting.
why: Accor is Europe's largest hospitality company, operating international hotel chains including Sofitel, Novotel, and Ibis.

impacts.name: Accor
impacts.why: The top shareholder launched an activist campaign seeking the chief executive's replacement.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Activist pressure from the lead shareholder increased board friction and executive turnover risk.
